title: Gene Polymorphism Associated With Macroangiopathy in Type 2 Diabetes Patients
brief_summary: To explore the possible implications of HLA-DRB1\*04 alleles in patients with type 2 DM and macroangiopathy
study_population: 150 healthy blood donors without a family history of diabetes mellitus at the Harbin Blood Disease Research Center were enrolled in the study, and 320 outpatients and hospitalized patients of type 2 diabetes mellitus from the First and Second Affiliated Hospital of Harbin Medical University.
